data_dir.description: Directory where CRM114 stores trained classifier data, dictionaries, and persistent state.

mail_spool.description: Path to the mailbox (e.g., Maildir, MBox) used for training or batch classification. Set to 'none' to disable.

debug.description: Enable detailed logging to aid debugging. Set to true only for troubleshooting.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory (in MB) CRM114 may use. 0 means no limit.

preprocessors.description: Ordered list of preprocessor filter paths (e.g., to strip HTML, decode MIME, normalize whitespace).

items.description: Absolute path to a preprocessor filter binary or script (e.g., /usr/lib/crm114/preproc/html_strip)

classifier_name.description: Name of the core classifier algorithm to use (e.g., dispm, svm, bcl).

training_method.description: Training mode — 'online' for incremental updates, 'batch' for full retraining.

min_word_freq.description: Minimum occurrence frequency for a token to be included in the model.

max_features.description: Upper limit on the number of tokens the model will consider.

spam_threshold.description: Probability threshold above which an email is classified as spam (range 0.0–1.0).

discriminators.description: List of discriminator/filter names (e.g., 'word' = tokenization, 'bword' = bi-grams).

items.description: Name of a discriminator module (e.g., word, bword, regexp, keyword, body).

extensions.description: Optional CRM114 extension modules to enable (e.g., bayes, regexp).

items.description: Name of an extension module to activate (e.g., bayes).

output_format.description: Output format for classification results (e.g., mail, text, json).

add_headers.description: When true, append X-CRM114-Status and related headers to classified messages.
